decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority (before the building(s) is/are occupied/used).

Condition : 3 - External materials shall be those agreed under planning permission 84/39-41/P7(a) i.e. Butley Old English Light Reds unless otherwise approved by the Local Planning Authority in writing. All new joinery shall be of painted timber.

Condition : 4 - Reasons for approval: The development complies with the Council's U.D.P. policies ENV-B.1.1., ENV-B.2.2. and H.6.4 , and the U.D.P. Supplementary Guidance relating to Bedford Park Conservation Area.
description: Erection of single storey rear extension to Hotel
